title: Amplitude Modulation & Demodulation Trainer Kit

groups.title: General System Architecture & Enclosure
items: Complete bench-top educational training platform designed for undergraduate engineering and physics laboratories to study amplitude modulation and demodulation.
High-grade, multi-color mimic diagram on the front panel with clearly labeled functional blocks, standard circuit schematics, expected test waveforms, and signal flow paths.
Front Panel Visual Indicators: Real-time LED status indicators showing active carrier paths, functional block selection, and signal flow direction.

Built-in Transducers & Audio I/O: Integrated condenser microphone with pre-amplifier, 3.5 mm external microphone/audio input jack, 3.5 mm earphone output jack, and an on-board loudspeaker with volume control for voice communication experiments.
Enclosure: Compact, durable powder-coated metal / ABS enclosure with integrated internal regulated DC power supplies and mains supply fuse protection.

groups.title: Modulation Transmitter Section
items: Audio Modulating Signal Generator: On-board variable audio frequency sine-wave oscillator covering 300 Hz / 400 Hz to at least 3.4 kHz, with independent continuous amplitude and frequency controls.
RF Carrier Generator: Stable crystal/transistor oscillator generating a 1 MHz sinusoidal carrier signal with low harmonic distortion.
Modulator Stages: Minimum two balanced modulators with output bandpass filtering at 1 MHz for Double Sideband Suppressed Carrier (DSB-SC) and Double Sideband Full Carrier (DSB-FC) generation.
One balanced modulator with center frequency around 450 kHz to 455 kHz for Single Sideband (SSB) generation.
Filter Circuits: On-board ceramic bandpass filter centered at 455 kHz (±2 kHz) to achieve precise Single Sideband Suppressed Carrier (SSB-SC) filtering.
Transmission Antenna: Adjustable multi-section telescopic antenna mounted on the transmitter panel to support low-power wireless radiation of generated AM signals.

groups.title: Demodulator Section
items: Balanced demodulator (synchronous detector) with SIGNAL IN, CARRIER and DEMOD OUT sockets for recovering DSB-SC and SSB-SC signals.
Audio power amplifier with volume control and on-board loudspeaker output for listening to the recovered audio.

groups.title: Diagnostics, Fault Simulation & Signal Observation
items: Transmitter Section: Minimum 20 insulated 2 mm shrouded banana sockets/test points for multi-channel oscilloscope probing across carrier generation, audio amplification, and balanced modulator stages.
Fault Simulation Facility: Built-in hardware fault switches (8 independent switched faults) enabling instructor-led hardware troubleshooting and student fault-diagnosis exercises.

groups.title: Electrical & Power Supply Specifications
items: Mains Input Supply: 220–240 V AC ±10%, 50 Hz single phase.
Internal DC Power: Built-in regulated DC power supplies (±12 V, ±5 V) with short-circuit and thermal overload protection.

groups.title: Scope of Supply & Documentation
items: 1 × Set of color-coded 2 mm patch cords for signal routing and interconnection.
1 × Pair of stereo earphones / headphones with 3.5 mm jack.
